name: cloudflare-worker-boilerplate
description: Boilerplate Cloudflare Workers: React (SPA) + Hono + D1, KV, R2, Queues, Durable Objects, Workflows, Cron, Rate limiting.

scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && vite dev
scripts.seed: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && node scripts/seed.mjs
scripts.seed:reset: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && node scripts/seed.mjs --reset
scripts.deploy: npm run check && vite build && wrangler deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run check && vite build --mode staging && wrangler deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
